main_text.p: tere,[?] & excussisse Spiritum Sanctum? Itáne propterea possunt, & faciunt illi, qui Spiritum adoptionis habent; ut electi, & oves Christi? Ille enim, ut ipsemet Melanchthon agnoscit, fugit Deum: non invocat; non statuit se juvari a Deo; non confidit Deo. Hunc nos dicemus habuisse Spiritum Sanctum filiorum Dei; & verorum Ecclesiae membrorum proprium? page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment cut off at the top edge ("tere," with the first letter uncertain). Marginal marks (») are printed quotation markers, not text; the reading of their shape is approximate. Italic runs are set where the scan shows italic type. Long s has been normalised to s throughout. The final word "bet" is printed on a separate line below the last line, with the hyphen from "ha-" joining it. Some letters in the upper lines are slightly blurred, so "electi" and "propriū" are the least certain readings.
